title: Digital Technology Delivery and Performance Lead

Are you passionate about turning strategy into brilliant execution, improving financial visibility, and simplifying how technology is governed and delivered? Challenge delivery plans constructively, facilitate issue resolution, and support recovery actions where performance is off track. Improve financial transparency, cost control, and decision-making through reliable data and timely insight. Identify financial risks and opportunities and coordinate corrective actions with accountable owners. Clarify accountabilities, decision rights, escalation paths, and performance expectations. Standardize practical ways of working that improve consistency, speed, and execution efficiency without creating unnecessary bureaucracy. Drive continuous improvement based on delivery data, stakeholder feedback, and lessons learned. Support portfolio prioritization and sequencing, balancing business value, cost, risk, dependencies, and delivery capacity. Contribute to technology landscape simplification by identifying overlaps, rationalization opportunities, and complexity reduction actions. Ensure initiatives remain aligned with Technology & Architecture priorities and Opella’s strategic objectives. Develop dashboards and management reporting that provide a trusted, concise view of portfolio performance. Translate delivery and financial data into actionable insights, options, and recommendations for leadership. Improve data quality and reporting automation to reduce manual effort and accelerate decision-making. Facilitate alignment across functions, surface trade-offs, and ensure actions and decisions are followed through. Act as a trusted partner to leadership, combining constructive challenge with pragmatic execution support. Where relevant, use AI-powered tools and digital solutions to improve productivity, streamline reporting, and simplify ways of working. Facilitate animation of team routines and coach our Teams to work in Agile ways of working and according to the Project Management methodology defined by our Digital group. Core Skills & Expertise Technology delivery and performance management. Project and portfolio management. Budget management, forecasting, purchase order management, and cost control. Technology governance, operating models, and decision frameworks. KPI development, analytics, and executive reporting. Stakeholder management and cross-functional leadership. Process optimization and continuous improvement. Digital transformation and AI enablement. Required Qualifications Significant experience in technology delivery, portfolio performance, PMO, finance, operations, or a comparable role in a complex international organization. Proven ability to manage budgets and forecasts, interpret financial data, and drive cost accountability. Strong understanding of project and portfolio governance, delivery methodologies, and technology operating models. Excellent analytical, communication, facilitation, and executive presentation skills. Ability to influence without direct authority, manage competing priorities, and operate effectively in ambiguity. Pragmatic, structured, detail-oriented, and able to connect strategic priorities with operational execution. Fluent English required; additional languages are an advantage. AI & Productivity: Microsoft Copilot and generative AI tools like Vibe Coding. Financial & Procurement Processes: budget tracking, forecasting, and SAP. Portfolio milestones, risks, dependencies, decisions, and accountabilities are transparent and actively managed. Budget forecasts are accurate, variances are understood, and financial actions are completed on time. Governance and reporting are simpler, more consistent, and focused on decisions and outcomes. Prioritization and landscape simplification decisions are supported by clear data and strategic alignment. Stakeholders recognize the function as a trusted partner that improves execution, accountability, and operational efficiency.
